limits: The 102-coordinate frame is conditional on one additional coordinate in a 101-position source. Advertised length alone is not proof of an exact historical loss location.
All 102 insertion boundaries are priced against the stated word proposal, including all five boundaries around the visibly short XVGF group. Two equal minimum choices are retained.
Observed substitutions, the one ambiguous-source-glyph fill and the one additional-coordinate fill are distinct costs. No observed coordinate is deleted or reordered.
The p189 E context supports the pump topic but is not a parallel ciphertext or numerical reference witness. No historical identity for Seifert is added.
